### 4. apply_diff
**功能**: 应用 SEARCH/REPLACE 格式的差异

**参数**:
```typescript
{
  path: string;        // 文件相对路径
  diff: string;        // SEARCH/REPLACE格式的差异
  start_line?: number; // 可选：起始行号
}
```

**diff格式**:
```
<<<<<<< SEARCH
old content here
=======
new content here
>>>>>>> REPLACE
```
